mentions.author: svat
mentions.text:
The Knuth approach said to be implemented in this post (but it looks like the code in the post simply guesses at random?) is described in:

> The computer as Master Mind. Journal of Recreational Mathematics 9 (1976), pp. 1–6. Reprinted with an addendum as Chapter 25 of Selected Papers on Fun and Games.

( [course] is the original paper, but the addendum in the 2011 book is 5 pages long, longer than the original article itself (not counting its figure/table), and discusses various later results/ideas.)
